hypothesis: R266's three macro gates constrain new entries but do not immediately exit existing positions. Keep R266 entry, ranking, universe, sizing and max-hold unchanged; exit positions when any gate is closed, using the system's next-session open. This may reduce risk exposure but can sell before a rapid reopening/rebound.

execution.exit_logic: OR of ERP < 5.5, credit spread factor < -0.8, or term spread < 0.3; next tradable session open fill.
execution.only_changed_behavior: add T+1 exits on any closed original entry gate; entry filter/ranking remain unchanged
execution.system_path: custom signal registry -> StrategyDependencyResolver -> StrategyBacktestService -> BacktestEngine -> T+1 signal exit

gates.P1: R266 control curve/trade cache hashes at 3x/4x/5x match finalized evidence and 3x R265 parity.
gates.P2: Live panel reload succeeds; candidate/control and all 3 exit signals/4 factors are registered; zero strategy load errors.
gates.G1: 3x full return is positive and retains >=70% of R266 full return.
gates.G8: 3x validation return retains >=70% of R266 validation return using prior-close-rebased basis.
gates.L1: 3x full mean losing-trade loss magnitude improves >=1pp versus R266.
gates.L2: 3x validation-entry mean losing-trade loss magnitude improves >=1pp versus R266.
gates.L3: 3x worst full completed trade is less negative than R266.
gates.L4: 3x worst validation-entry completed trade is less negative than R266.
gates.C3: Top three symbols net P&L share <=55%.
gates.C4: Top five symbols net P&L share <=75%.
gates.C5: At least 8 validation-entry symbols have positive P&L.
gates.C7: Largest single-symbol loss <=20% of gross profit.
gates.C8: Validation-period largest symbol net P&L share <=35%.

decision_rule: Only this frozen candidate is run; every P/G/R/L/C gate must pass. Any failed or unknown gate rejects it. No threshold changes or follow-up grid in this round.
known_limitations: R266 and its validation interval have been used by extensive prior research; this is exploratory, not independent confirmation or an untouched holdout.
Macro time series are aligned to stored dates; publication timestamps and PIT release lags are not independently established here.
Historical HS300 membership and macro-source data can have revision risk.
Daily OHLC cannot reproduce queue priority; T+1 exits remain blocked by suspension or limit-down execution constraints.
Exit signals use the stored daily gate state; positions can remain exposed until the next tradable open.
A passing research test does not authorize paper trading or production; production remains pause_production.
